_provenance.note: Official Kartoza / GeoSpatialHosting brand colours, supplied by Tim on 2026-08-28. These replace the values previously derived from the live site by reading the logo SVG and the bundle CSS; the derived ones were close but not exact (accent was #ECB44B, now #DF9E2F). This file is the ONLY place brand values live — correcting it re-themes the web UI, the wallpaper and the splash together.

official.color.muted: highlight3, grey — also the wallpaper wordmark

derived.color.accentHover: no official hover tone was supplied; this is highlight1 darkened for the pressed/hover state
derived.color.textMuted: no official muted-text tone; highlight3 grey is used

rejected.Avenir: the site self-hosts Avenir TTFs, but Avenir is a commercial Linotype face and must not be redistributed inside a container image. Lato is SIL OFL and is what the site sets on body.
rejected.Sen: loaded by the site from Google Fonts but never observed being applied, and the egress lockdown would block a runtime fetch anyway.
